sample_unit: benchmark scenarios (3 XAI methods x 2 models x 2 datasets)

links.outcome: Overlap (IoU, DSC) between XAI explanations and radiologist-delineated pneumothorax lesions, baseline versus template-guided
links.effect: Template guidance improved baseline XAI in all 12 scenarios; average incremental improvement was 97.8% in IoU and 94.1% in DSC, indicating baseline explanations often diverged from true lesion areas.
links.quote: The proposed approach consistently improved baseline XAI methods across twelve benchmark scenarios built on three XAI methods, two DL models, and two datasets.

unlisted_practices: Template-guided filtering of post hoc XAI saliency maps using radiologist lesion-derived clinical knowledge

screen.reason: The study tests a post-processing safeguard/practice (superimposing a clinical domain template onto XAI heatmaps to filter out extraneous explanations) across existing DL models and XAI methods on benchmark datasets.

primary.practice: post-hoc explanation filtering using clinical templates
